title: Error in the SAPUI5 repository, which is a local object of the user xxx
symptom: Deploying from SAP Business Application Studio or VS Code fails with a message saying the repository is a local object belonging to another user.
rootCause: Not verified. Likely: the repository was created earlier in package $TMP (a local object) by a different user. Local objects are bound to the user who created them and cannot be shared.

solutions.label: Deploy to a transportable package instead of $TMP
solutions.body:
$TMP is for personal throwaway experiments only. Anything shared must live in a Z* package with a transport.

Note: once created in $TMP the package cannot be changed — the object has to be deleted and recreated, or a different name used.

solutions.label: Ask the owner to delete the local object
solutions.body: Only the user who created a local object can delete it in ADT. After deletion, deploy again into a transportable package.

prevention: Ban $TMP for any app another person will use or that will move to QA. Add it to the code review checklist: verify `app.package` in ui5-deploy.yaml.
